basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old outdoor enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. I work as a software engineer with a passion for learning new programming languages and technologies. When I'm not coding, I enjoy hiking, camping, and spending time with my two rescue dogs. I'm married with no kids, and my spouse and I love exploring new cuisines and cooking together. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, especially after a long day at work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from Oregon State University and have over 15 years of experience working in the tech industry. My expertise spans front-end development and cloud computing. I am self-taught in several programming languages and enjoy contributing to open-source projects in my spare time.
